scope: Reusable hardware-free PPU RX digital-interface matrix validation. Native collection, hardware calibration, static board timing, RX throughput and RF qualification remain separate.
implementation: Strict bounded ASCII parser for exactly one complete 16x16 Linux AD9361 bist_timing_analysis report. Data-delay rows and clock-delay columns must be present in exact order with only o/. cells.
Assess an explicitly supplied selected setting and expected physical sample clock; do not choose a favorable unrelated cell or accept a different rate.
Caller explicitly chooses data-line, clock-line or complete-square margin and minimum radius. No clipping or wrapping of unmeasured boundary cells, and no implied nanosecond/PVT/bit-error margin.
Retain well-formed negative observations, all rejection reasons, original report, SHA256 and parsed matrix. Malformed data is rejected rather than repaired or silently truncated.

No discovery, IIO, setting writes, calibration, firmware promotion, changed PPU defaults or native collection implementation. Serial/boot/firmware/freshness/readback/restoration attestation remains external.

findings: The timing-report generator changes delays, RX PRBS, ENSM/pin-control and TX attenuation before attempting restoration. It is not an ordinary read-only health query.
ad9361_dig_tune can clear a tuning failure return when max_freq is zero. Successful command return alone must not satisfy the matrix gate.
The normal tuner can select zero on one delay axis. A measured margin along the other axis is a distinct claim from a complete square margin.
source_review.limit: Local pinned source review, not observation of an installed radio/kernel.

targeted_tests.coverage: Rate ladder including 15/25/30/60MS/s, asymmetric axis orientation, all-fail and wrong-rate controls, exact radii 0..7, every square neighbor, both one-dimensional axes, grid edges, malformed/duplicate/reordered/truncated reports, original hash preservation, immutable receipt and strict configuration.
targeted_tests.fixture_limit: Synthetic text only; no calibration or RF evidence.
